newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle 1996 profit to match sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Nestle 1996 profit to match sales growth.

text.p: Nestle SA said it expected 1996 group net profit growth to at least match sales growth and said group sales should approach 60 billion Swiss francs for the year.
"For the full year 1996, Nestle expects the favourable trend in sales to continue, and consolidated sales for the year should approach 60 billion francs," it said in a statement.
"For the whole of 1996, net profit should grow at least at the same rate as consolidated sales."
Nestle posted 1995 group net profit of 2.92 billion francs on consolidated sales of 56.48 billion. --Zurich +41 1 631 7340
